This update improves saving and export options, along with a few everyday interface interactions.

- Menus have more consistent click areas and handling around unavailable actions. Save All also includes new, untitled documents without edits. Related to issue 219.
- Save As has a more flexible layout, background previews and clearer output details. Export settings are remembered by format after saving. Related to issue 221.
- PNG export gains colour, bit-depth, compression and palette options, including dithering and partial transparency. GIF dithering and TIFF compression handling have also been improved.
- Configuration-resource pickers avoid adding files to Windows recent documents. Preferences > AI includes cleanup for currently configured resource paths. Related to issue 220.
- Retired experimental Heifer decoder and encoder code has been removed. Related to issue 196.
